basic_details.job_title: GGU Junior Research Fellow I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya (GGU) has notified 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow I (JRF-I) post under a contract engagement. how_to_apply: Compile self-attested copies of educational certificates and mark sheets.
Attach a list of publications/patents, if applicable.

Send or submit the application by post or in person to reach the office of the Coordinator, DST-Technology Enabling Centre (TEC), Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur - 495009, Chhattisgarh on or before 30 October 2026. content_sections.heading: GGU Junior Research Fellow I (JRF-I) at a Glance

rows.details: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India
Initially for six months or till completion of the project (extendable based on project requirements)
Offline (by post or in person) / Email (for eligible candidates as per notice conditions)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: UG Degree in a relevant field (such as Engineering, Sciences, Management, etc., or related disciplines) from a recognized University/Institute, with a minimum of 55% marks. Desirable Qualifications: Candidates possessing a Master's degree in a relevant field or discipline from a recognized University/Institution will be preferable. Relevant experience in technology development, technology transfer, innovation management, Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), startup and entrepreneurship ecosystem, incubation, industry liaison, project management, and technology commercialization will be preferred. Good communication, report writing, documentation, coordination, and organizational skills. Research/project experience in academic institutions, research organizations, innovation Centre’s, incubation centres, or related organizations will be preferred. Experience in handling Government-funded projects/schemes will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is fixed at Rs. 32,000 per month. The appointment is purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project. The initial tenure is for six months or till completion of the project, and it may be extended based on project requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GGU Junior Research Fellow I (JRF-I)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Compile self-attested copies of educational certificates and mark sheets. Attach experience certificates, if any. Attach a list of publications/patents, if applicable. Send or submit the application by post or in person to reach the office of the Coordinator, DST-Technology Enabling Centre (TEC), Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur - 495009, Chhattisgarh on or before 30 October 2026. Alternatively, candidates fulfilling the conditions may send their applications on plain paper through E-mail ( [email protected] ) mentioning personal contact information and academic credentials along with self-attested testimonials by 30/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Fulfilment of minimum qualifications shall not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. The tentative date of interview is 16/11/2026 at 10 AM at DST-TEC Centre, Old Forestry Building, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Koni, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed separately via email/phone regarding the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the GGU Junior Research Fellow-I position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for the JRF-I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are selected based on their qualifications and experience, and only those shortlisted will be informed separately via email or phone regarding the interview.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the DST-TEC Centre, Old Forestry Building, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Koni, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.
